record_scope: A-approved FP32 comparison values; B execution interpretation and pending operational decisions are distinguished below
ordered_pairs_provenance: B proposal https://github.com/soogwon/soloLevelingPaper/issues/391#issuecomment-6917195081 expanded to preserve A-approved six fresh processes per backend; not a verbatim A quotation
warm_aggregation: median of six per-process medians of three warm runs
rss_aggregation: maximum of six process-tree peak RSS samples per backend
cold_policy: record median, maximum and ratio; no independent failure threshold
baseline_unstable_policy: defer comparison; do not pass or fail candidate
failed_measurement_policy: preserve failure and record retry decision; no automatic retry authorized
b_execution_guard_not_an_additional_a_th: No retry in this preparation task; explicit retry budget and execution timeout remain pending. Runtime failures are retained, not discarded to refill successful samples.
replacement_policy: preserve existing context, embedding set and publication; validate new embedding_set_id separately
